responsibility: Declares the derive expander for builtin #[derive(Hash)] in gcc/rust/expand. The DeriveHash class exposes the go entry point plus helpers that build Hash::hash call expressions, the generic hash associated function with its Hasher bound, the enclosing core::hash::Hash impl, and enum-pattern helpers for tuple and struct variants, defining the interface macro expansion uses to synthesize Hash implementations.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the Hash derive pair: it declares DeriveHash, its helper methods, and enum-pattern helper interfaces, in contrast to rust-derive-hash.cc, which implements the actual AST generation for derived Hash impls.
